text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3,"unit":"magazines","kind":"count","span":"orders 3 magazines"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"issues","kind":"count","span":"send 12 issues a year"},{"id":"q3","value":1,"unit":"magazine","kind":"count","span":"has 1 magazine"},{"id":"q4","value":6,"unit":"issues","kind":"count","span":"sends 6 issues a year"},{"id":"q5","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"4 times the amount"},{"id":"q6","value":6,"unit":"issues","kind":"count","span":"the 6 issue magazine"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"issues a year from the three twelve-issue magazines"},{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"issues a year from the single six-issue magazine"},{"op":"mul","args":["q4","q5"],"out":"s3","note":"the last magazine sends four times the six-issue magazine's yearly issues"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"issues from the first two groups of magazines"},{"op":"add","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"add the last magazine's issues for the yearly total"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the total number of magazine issues Susan receives in a year"},"dismissed":[{"value":6,"reason":"the 6 in 'the 6 issue magazine' merely names again the same six-issue magazine already captured as q4, so it is not a separate input"}]}
